integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the chest up, calm and ordinary. The camera pushes in at slow speed. A thin line appears on the skin along the inside of the forearm and opens like an eyelid: a perfectly formed human eye looks out, glistening, and blinks. A moment later a second line opens beside it, then a third, each eye appearing in the same neat row at the same careful distance, until there are four of them. They blink slightly out of time with one another, and each one looks in its own direction. <Subject 1>'s own eyes stay wide and still, as if afraid that moving them would wake the others. In the final moment the newest eye opens last and it is a different colour from all the others.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, shallow breathing, a soft moist click each time an eye opens, and overlapping blinks like tiny wet shutters.
